title: LoRA on a linear layer
hints: Freeze the base with p.requires_grad_(False). Create A = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(r, in_features) / sqrt(in_features)) and B = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(out_features, r)); B = 0 makes the update start at exactly zero.
forward: base(x) + (x @ A.T @ B.T) * (alpha / r). Two thin matmuls; never form the (out, in) product during training.
merge: under torch.no_grad(), base.weight += (B @ A) * scaling and set a flag so forward skips the LoRA path; unmerge subtracts the same thing and clears the flag.
